TRUE FLAGSHIP SPECS
Compare the specifications of the Equus engine against those from other flagship
luxury sedans. As you run through the numbers, you’ll see that it’s all there: 5.0-liter
displacement. Up to 429 horsepower with a peak torque figure of 376 lb-ft.1 And
most impressive for an engine of its size and power, an EPA highway rating of 23
MPG – a figure enhanced by an all-aluminum design that is lightweight, yet durable.
VEHICLE STABILITY MANAGEMENT
A sophisticated Vehicle Stability Management system links and optimizes the
function of active and passive safety features. VSM incorporates the Electronic
Stability and Traction Control Systems, Anti-lock Braking System, Brake Assist,
Electronic Brake-force Distribution and a Lane Departure Warning System.2
GASOLINE DIRECT INJECTION
Technology continues to evolve the internal combustion engine. Our Tau 5.0L
V8 uses next-generation technology to inject high-pressure fuel directly into the
combustion chambers. It’s a more precisely controlled combustion, resulting in
superior power, lower emissions and improved fuel economy.
RIDING ON AIR
While some other luxury sedans offer it only as an option, Equus comes standard
with Electronically Controlled Air Suspension. Along with Continuous Damping
Control, it gives the Equus a feeling of total composure, with optimum body control
and ride height.
ADVANCED BRAKING SYSTEM
If you think Equus’s ability to accelerate is impressive, consider its braking technologies.
Abundant stopping power comes from four-piston ABS front calipers gripping large
brake rotors that are ventilated to remain cool under repeated hard braking, thus
minimizing brake fade. Allowing you, the driver, to remain cool and confident, too.
1 Premium fuel ratings. 2 Vehicle Stability Management (VSM) cannot control your vehicle’s stability under all driving situations. VSM is not a substitute for safe driving practices. No
system, no matter how advanced, can overcome physics or correct poor driving. The driver is always responsible for controlling the vehicle and must use caution to avoid loss
of control in all driving conditions. Speed, road conditions and driver steering input will affect whether VSM can help prevent loss of control. See Owner’s Manual for details. The
Traction Control System is meant to enhance conscientious driving habits and is not a substitute for safe driving practices.

EQUUS SIGNATURE
KEY STANDARD EQUIPMENT:
• 429 HP, 5.0L Gasoline Direct Injection DOHC Tau® V8 engine with Dual Continuously • Power windows with auto-down/up
Variable Valve Timing • Windshield wiper de-icer, rain-sensing wipers and auto-defogging windshield with humidity sensor
• 8-speed automatic transmission with SHIFTRONIC® • Acoustic laminated windshield, front and rear-side windows
• Electro-Hydraulic Power Steering • Power tilt-and-slide glass sunroof
• Electronically controlled air suspension with Continuous Damping Control • 60/40 power reclining and heated rear seats
• Proximity key entry with push-button start • Power rear sunshade
• Dual automatic temperature control with Air Quality System • Illuminated scuff plates, inside door handles and door armrest
• Leather-wrapped dash and real wood interior trim • 9-airbag safety system: Advanced dual front airbags, front and rear seat-mounted side-impac t
• Premium leather seats and microfiber suede headliner airbags, driver knee airbag, and roof-mounted side-curtain airbags
• 12-way power adjustable driver seat with lumbar support • Vehicle Stability Management with pre-collision warning
• 10-way power adjustable front passenger seat • Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control System
• Driver seat massage system • Tire Pressure Monitoring System
• Heated and cooled front seats • 4-wheel disc Anti-lock Braking System with Brake Assist and Electronic Brake-force Distribution
• Integrated Memory System for driver seat, side mirrors and steering wheel • Electronic parking brake with automatic vehicle hold
• Heated leather/wood-trimmed power tilt-and-telescopic steering wheel • Electronic active front head restraints with power controls
• Lexicon® 7.1 Discrete surround-sound audio system with 17 speakers • Electronic seatbelt pretensioners
• Pemium navigation system with integrated Driver Information System and multimedia controller • 19" chrome alloy wheels
• iPod®/USB and MP3 auxiliary input jacks with iPod connection cable • Xenon High Intensity Discharge automatic headlights with LED turn signal indicators
• Bluetooth® hands-free phone system • Adaptive Front Lighting System with auto-leveling headlights
• Front and rear parking assistance system with rearview camera • Front fog lights
• Lane Departure Warning System • Dual power-folding heated auto-dimming side mirrors with integrated turn signal indicators
• Smart Cruise Control and approach lamps
• Electroluminescent Supervision cluster with 3.5” LCD screen • Lower chrome side-door accents
• Electrochromic auto-dimming rearview mirror with HomeLink® and compass • Dual asymmetrical exhaust tips integrated into rear bumper
EQUUS ULTIMATE
EQUUS SIGNATURE STANDARD EQUIPMENT PLUS:
+ Rear-seat entertainment system with 8” display + Power rear-seat head restraints with manual tilt adjustment
+ Power 50/50 split rear seats with reclining function + Power rear side-window sunshades
+ Cooled rear seats + Illuminated rear-seat vanity mirrors
+ First-class right rear seat with integrated leg support and massage functions + Forward-view cornering camera
+ Thermoelectric rear console refrigerator + Power open/close trunk access

HYUNDAI AT YOUR SERVICE
The service center comes to you. The owner’s manual is available as a downloadable Apple iPad® app. Hyundai’s
At Your Service is an entirely new kind of luxury service. For an entirely new kind of luxury car.
• Free Maintenance: All of the normal scheduled maintenance included in the Equus Owner’s Manual is covered
for 5 years or 60,000 miles.
• Valet Service: When it’s time for an oil change, tune-up or any other service, contact us by phone or iPad app.
We’ll pick up your car, deliver a courtesy replacement vehicle, and return your Equus when it’s ready.
• Customer Connect Center: Get quick answers to questions about warranty coverage, feature functionality, and more.
(877) 378-8727 seven days a week from 5:00 am to 9:00 pm (PST).
